paper_id: Mandheling_ Mixed-Precision On-Device DNN Training with DSP Offloading
title: Mandheling: Mixed-Precision On-Device DNN Training with DSP Offloading
motivation: On-device DNN training is prohibitively expensive (ResNet-50训练需4.6GB内存/36.4秒),现有inference优化不适用于training
problem_framing: 如何通过DSP卸载+混合精度训练协同优化on-device训练性能,同时保证收敛精度
key_insight: DSP擅长INT8矩阵运算,但需解决4个training特有的挑战: DSP不友好算子、动态rescaling开销、DSP缓存压力、图准备开销
method_signature: CPU-DSP协同调度+自适应rescaling+batch分割+子图复用
evaluation_criteria: 训练时间、能耗、收敛精度损失;对比TFLite/MNN/FP32基线
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 未支持FP8和某些INT8训练算法,因缺乏对应低精度算子支持
evidence_for_taste: some operators like Transpose and Normalization run slowly on DSP
we observe a disparity between using DSP to serve training and inference tasks
a vanilla DSP training engine can achieve very limited or even negative performance gain
preparing the compute graph takes a considerable amount of time
thinking_moves: 将inference优化方法与training workload对比,指出不能直接迁移的原因
通过micro-experiments发现scale factor在训练后期稳定在少量取值
将OS内存管理思想(MRU)引入DSP子图复用,利用训练中模型结构不变的特点
用动态规划求解算子到CPU/DSP的最优分配问题,考虑context switch开销
